senses.definition_en: synonym of ciclista (“cyclist”) (person who rides a cycle)

examples.english: We are talking about Viñales National Park, declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1999, where hundreds of cyclists tackled a grueling internal circuit with more than 1,000 meters of elevation gain and 73 kilometers, seven of which were neutralized or connecting stages to cross the town's main avenue, packed with fans cheering on the riders.
examples.ref: 2015 December 9, Aliet Arzola Lima, “Todo o nada en Cayo Jutías”, in Granma, retrieved 25 Dec 2025:
examples.text: Hablamos del Parque Nacional de Viñales, declarado “Patrimonio Cultural de la Humanidad” por la UNESCO en 1999, donde los cientos de pedalistas afrontaron un extenuante circuito interno de más de mil metros de desnivel y 73 kilómetros, siete de ellos neutralizados o de enlace para surcar la avenida principal del pueblo, repleta de aficionados que animaron a los corredores.
examples.translation: We are talking about Viñales National Park, declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1999, where hundreds of cyclists tackled a grueling internal circuit with more than 1,000 meters of elevation gain and 73 kilometers, seven of which were neutralized or connecting stages to cross the town's main avenue, packed with fans cheering on the riders.
